message: CITY buildings retain their architecture when acquired. Willow Galleria now occupies a four-plot city block, with broad shopping wings, a glass atrium and roads routed around its perimeter. Shops have colourful neon nameboards at night. The city also includes a petrol station and 12 controlled traffic-light junctions. Seven selected packs and nine additional packs are active; the other two remain imported. The first browser download is about 115 MB. Business rules, staffing, stock and progression use the same game logic.

packs.name: European Forests - Realistic Trees
packs.use: Birch, ash and spruce trees, with reduced detail at longer viewing distances.

packs.name: Apartment Kit
packs.use: Beds, lounge seating and coffee equipment in business interiors.

packs.name: Low Poly Road Vehicles Free Package
packs.use: Sedans, pickups, sports cars, vans and factory delivery trucks on the existing road routes.

packs.name: Urban building
packs.use: Imported and retained for comparison; the active scenery now uses CITY package buildings.

packs.name: UK Terraced Houses Pack FREE
packs.use: Imported and retained; CITY package houses are now active in this edition.

packs.name: EasyRoads3D Free v3
packs.use: Only the asphalt normal texture is used. Road meshes, intersections and layout were not built with the EasyRoads3D editor.

packs.name: Cute Low Poly Kitchen Pack - Colorful Interior Props
packs.use: Kitchen racks and bread displays in restaurants.

packs.name: EmbersStorm - Free Air Vehicles Planes, Helicopters & Fighter Jets Pack
packs.use: Airliners at the terminal and on the existing arrival and departure routes.

packs.name: CITY package
packs.use: 26 prepared designs: six house models and 20 commercial styles across 319 homes and 80 scenery parcels. Existing CITY buildings retain their exterior when acquired; new construction uses the glass-fronted business models.
